items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: And so a year later, I was in his band.

ctx.x: And they called it Wycliffe's Jazz Band, and the city wouldn't allow him to put up that song.

Word jazz, and he called it the Ginger Band. Your information is perfect because, excuse me, I know Wycliffe. Wycliffe was kind of fond of me because he had seen me come up with the violin. We had roomed at the same place, you know, and he heard me practicing, and he'd say, You're going to make it. He says, You'll make it. And so a year later, I was in his band. And he told me a lot of things. A lot of things encouraged me, and told me that Clarence Lee was a wonderful violinist, but when he got a little too much…
There's another violinist around about that time, Jimmy Bell.
